claim_scope: local subset experiment; not Kaggle leaderboard evidence

selection.target_rule: first 5 train_labels.csv columns whose names start with target_

metric.local_definition: for each selected target, compute Spearman correlation over the 50 holdout rows; then divide the mean of those 5 target-level correlations by their standard deviation
metric.local_aggregation_axis: target-wise time-series correlations, then aggregate across targets
metric.competition_definition_from_official_pag: mean Spearman rank correlation between predictions and targets divided by the standard deviation
metric.competition_relation: not established as metric-equivalent. The repository implementation explicitly computes target-wise correlations over time, while the official page does not by itself bind this artifact to the competition metric code or aggregation axis. Do not describe this result as using the Kaggle metric until the official metric implementation is reproduced exactly.
